brief: The canvas displays a slow, mesmerizing cosmic tide of translucent, overlapping circles. Scattered throughout this flow are pointillist stars that leave behind bright, glowing arcing light trails. When the circles interact with these luminous wakes, temporary flares momentarily expand into radiating, dissipating rings of light. These dissipating rings leave behind faint, structural glows that briefly illuminate the movement of the surrounding fluid environment. The entire scene is a continuously flowing, ethereal spectacle, mesmerizing to observe without any direct input.

statement: This sketch creates an ethereal cosmic scene where translucent circles flow slowly across the canvas in a mesmerizing tide. Scattered throughout this fluid environment are pointillist stars that leave behind bright, glowing arcing light trails. When these luminous wakes interact with the flowing circles, temporary flares expand into radiating rings of light that dissipate over time. The scene is filled with faint structural glows from the lingering effects of these interactions, creating an immersive, continuously evolving spectacle. The entire animation runs without any input, driven purely by the natural flow of the elements, creating a hypnotic visual experience that feels both organic and otherworldly.
